# Multi-record structured commands emit one JSON object per line.

exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-16T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix jsonl-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: jsonl-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

# An empty collection emits no JSON values.
exec card --json list
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec card create 'First issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-first.txt

# A one-record collection emits one JSON value without an array wrapper.
exec card --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/list-one.jsonl
! stderr .

exec card create --priority 1 'Second issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-second.txt

# Record order remains deterministic for a multi-record collection.
exec card --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/list-many.jsonl
! stderr .

-- golden/create-first.txt --
jsonl-1
-- golden/create-second.txt --
jsonl-2
-- golden/list-one.jsonl --
{"id":"jsonl-1","title":"First issue","type":"task","lifecycle":"open","status":"ready","priority":2,"active_claim":null,"created":1784203200,"updated":1784203200,"revision":2,"labels":[],"blocked":false}
-- golden/list-many.jsonl --
{"id":"jsonl-2","title":"Second issue","type":"task","lifecycle":"open","status":"ready","priority":1,"active_claim":null,"created":1784203200,"updated":1784203200,"revision":3,"labels":[],"blocked":false}
{"id":"jsonl-1","title":"First issue","type":"task","lifecycle":"open","status":"ready","priority":2,"active_claim":null,"created":1784203200,"updated":1784203200,"revision":2,"labels":[],"blocked":false}
